messages.text: Friday, October 9 · Canton, Michigan
Overcast skies, a new moon, and NASA's heat shield tests

An overcast but mild day settles over Canton, with the new moon offering a dark sky for any stargazing. NASA is testing new heat shield technologies, while local events offer a variety of evening entertainment.
Expect an overcast day with a high near 69°F and a low around 42°F.
Sunrise is at 7:40 AM and sunset at 7:02 PM, under a new moon with 2.3% illumination.
Evening diversions near and far

For an evening of improvised comedy, consider "Big Fun Murder" at Go Comedy! Improv Theater in Ferndale at 9:30 PM. Alternatively, "Theatre L: My Daddy is Haunted" offers a horror-comedy performance at Planet Ant Theatre in Detroit starting at 8:00 PM.
Pop's birthday is coming up on October 12th.
Local Halloween yard haunts feature creative displays

Several local yard haunts are preparing for Halloween, featuring handcrafted elements and creative displays. Bryan Slowic's yard haunt in Libertyville, in operation since 2021, includes spooky music and fog machines, while Darren Rich's display in Algonquin uses creepy animatronics.
Upcoming events in Ann Arbor

Tomorrow, catch Fay Victor's Herbie Nichols SUNG at Kerrytown Concert House in Ann Arbor at 10:00 PM. On Sunday, consider "Drag Becomes Her" at The Michigan at 6:00 PM or "Off Book the Improvised Musical" at The Ark at 6:30 PM.

Saturday, October 10 · Canton, Michigan
Overcast warmth, space tech, and a haunted theater

A mild, overcast Saturday offers a local performance celebrating a century of Detroit's Senate Theater, alongside advancements in NASA's heat shield technology. The day's weather is expected to be warm and cloudy.
Today will be overcast with a high near 75°F and a low around 53°F, with a 3% chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:41 AM, sunset at 7:00 PM, with the moon new and 0.3% illuminated.
Saturday's notable events

Consider the Party of the Century at The Senate Theater in Detroit, celebrating 100 years with live music and performances starting at midnight. For a technically focused option, SynthFest offers a free event to solder an oscillator at the Downtown Library: Secret Lab Annex in Ann Arbor starting at 12:30 PM.
Pop's Birthday is coming up on Monday, October 12th.
Local Halloween haunts continue to evolve

Several local Halloween yard haunts are noted for their evolving displays. Bryan Slowic's "Bones Cove" in Libertyville, featuring music and fog, and Darren Rich's "Dark Chapel" in Algonquin with animatronics, are among those noted. Kitty Fishman's "Bone-a-Palooza" in Highland Park continues to grow, now in its sixth year.
Looking ahead to Sunday and beyond
Tomorrow, catch "Drag Becomes Her" at The Michigan in Ann Arbor at 6:00 PM, or enjoy "Off Book the Improvised Musical" at The Ark, also in Ann Arbor, at 6:30 PM.
